newsitem.title: USA: Rite Aid to build Md. distribution site.
newsitem.headline: Rite Aid to build Md. distribution site.

text.p: Rite Aid Corp said on Friday that it plans to build a 850,000 square foot distribution center on a 125-acre tract in Perryman, Md.
The distribution center will initially employ 400 people at its opening in fall 1998, Rite Aid said.
Rite Aid expects to take the facility to full operating capacity within three years of its opening, employing approximately 850 workers, it said.

Rite Aid will invest $60 million to $70 million in the project, including land, building, equipment and systems, the company said. The new facility will take over much of the distribution currently handled by a Harrisburg, Pa. center by the end of 1998, Rite Aid said.
Rite Aid will break ground on the new facility next month, and expects to open in the fall of 1998, the company said.
The company said it is studying alternative uses for the facility, which employs about 500 workers represented by the Teamsters Union.
A company spokesman said the company is negotiating with the Teamsters Union about the Harrisburg employees' jobs prospects.
